displayName: Gem supply rate by tier / biome
description: Measures per-hour acquisition of each gem tier across biomes for the 'balanced' playstyle. Tier-1 gems (Quartz, Obsidian) should be reliable — 5-10 per 40h. Tier-2 (Amethyst, Emerald, Topaz, Aquamarine) meaningful — 2-4 per 40h across all biomes combined. Tier-3 (Diamond, Black Pearl) scarce but present — 0-2 per 40h. If tier-3 never appears in a 40h sim that is a content bug; bump drop weights for the tier-3 entries in loot-tables.json biome-mountain / biome-desert / biome-water / biome-wyrd pools. NOTE: this playbook is an economy-sim spec, not a viability playbook — it is consumed by the gem-supply economy evaluator (follow-up). Today the file is a content contract that the economy-sim command can load; acceptance is via the content-layer test that verifies gems referenced here match the loot-tables entries.

biomeCoverage.comment: Which gem IDs each biome pool must be able to produce.

alerts.tier3Missing: If a 40h balanced sim produces zero tier-3 gems, treat as a content bug. First remediation: double the weight on Diamond/Black Pearl entries.
alerts.tier1Flooding: If tier-1 output exceeds 25 per 40h, substrate gems are devaluing standard taper drops — halve Quartz weight.
